assignments.reason: Attachment to tzaddikim is, by essential nature, the spiritual bond to holy righteous figures that is the root of prophetic speech-power. The teaching states 'פה אתקריאת מסטרא דצדיק' — the mouth (speech) is called/derives from the side of the tzaddik. The tzaddik is thus the essential source-aspect of the speech domain. Since Package 1 is the cluster of prophetic speech — דבורים, דבור התפלה, נביאים, כפים/יד הנביאים — the tzaddik-attachment belongs here by nature: it is the holy root from which the entire speech-prophecy domain draws its vitality.

The power of speech (כח הדבור) is, by essential nature, the activated capacity for holy speech. Package 1 contains דבורים (speeches/words), דבור התפלה (speech of prayer), נביאים (prophets as speech-beings), and כנפים (wings = words). כח הדבור is the power/force dimension of this same speech-reality — it IS speech in its potency-aspect. It belongs in the prophetic speech cluster by its inherent identity as a speech-concept, not because of its causal relationship to התקשרות לצדיקים.

Gazing upon the divine image (תמונת ה') is, by essential nature, prophetic vision — the perception of God's likeness as revealed through the prophets. The teaching identifies תמונת ה' as 'the imaginations/likenesses that we ascribe to Him — compassionate, gracious, etc. — all these likenesses the prophets revealed.' The divine image is thus inherently a prophetic-revelation concept. Package 1, the prophetic speech cluster, contains נביאים (prophets) and the entire apparatus of prophetic speech through which this image is revealed. מביטין בתמונת ה belongs in this package because its essential nature is prophetic perception of the divine, the telos of the entire prophetic-speech domain.

assignments.node_id: נכלל התפלה בתוך תורה שבכתב ותורה שבעל־פה שהם שני ידים יד כותבת ויד חותמת
assignments.reason: This compound node describes the encompassing of prayer within Written and Oral Torah as the two hands (writing hand and sealing hand). By essential nature, it is a statement about the Torah-prayer unity — prayer being included within the domain of Torah. Package 2 is precisely this cluster: תפלה, תורה שבכתב, יד כותבת, תורה שבעל-פה, יד חותמת. This node is a compound expression of the same essential reality that Package 2 represents — the structural identity between prayer and the two modes of Torah. It belongs here by its inherent nature as a Torah-prayer concept.
